steps: Turn off power (electric) or set gas valve to pilot.
Shut the cold water inlet valve and connect a hose to the drain valve, routed outside or to a drain.
Open a hot water faucet in the house to break the vacuum, then open the drain valve.
Let the tank drain fully until water runs clear; briefly open the cold inlet to stir remaining sediment.
Close the drain valve, remove the hose, refill the tank, then restore power/gas.
videoTitle: Guide to Draining and Flushing an Electric Water Heater - This Old House
